why_ai: Matching is pure software, though two-sided network effects keep marketplaces durable against AI-native entrants.
why_clarity: Match rate and sell-through are measurable across millions of listings, though unique inventory is harder.
why_digital: Listings, search and payments run online, with goods shipped by sellers.

why_ai: Ranking structured offers for a named item is learned ranking that AI shopping agents also perform.
why_clarity: Buyer satisfaction and conversion are measured on every search for identifiable products.
why_digital: Structured offer data ranked and shown entirely online.

why_ai: Network liquidity is a durable moat, though the matching levers themselves are engineering.
why_clarity: Match rate is measurable, but levers for one-of-a-kind inventory are contested.
why_digital: Matching buyers and sellers happens entirely in marketplace software.

why_ai: Turning photos and text into structured attributes is exactly what multimodal models now do.
why_clarity: Attributes extracted match the taxonomy or not, across millions of listings.
why_digital: Seller photos and text in, structured catalogue data out.

why_ai: Sold history is training data for price models, though unique items add ambiguity.
why_clarity: Sale versus no sale tests a price, but one-of-a-kind items lack references.
why_digital: Listing and sold-price data in, price guidance out, all online.

why_ai: Search and recommendation are core ML engineering that AI models continue to absorb.
why_clarity: Relevance and conversion are measured on every query at huge volume.
why_digital: Queries and listings are processed entirely in software.

why_ai: Listing assistance for new sellers is directly automatable with generative models.
why_clarity: Time to first sale and listing completeness are measurable for every new seller.
why_digital: Seller onboarding and listing flows happen entirely online.

why_ai: Distressed sellers value a human explaining a suspension, though reason retrieval automates.
why_clarity: Appeals recur, but resolution depends on opaque system decisions the agent cannot see.
why_digital: Appeals arrive and are handled through online support channels.

why_ai: Reviewers get only the ambiguous residue automation could not decide, on policy edges.
why_clarity: Reasonable people disagree on each case, and correctness is rarely confirmed.
why_digital: Listings, accounts and evidence are reviewed entirely on screen.

why_ai: Multimodal representation of unique items is improving fast and is a pure ML problem.
why_clarity: Buyers cannot name what they want, so relevance is partly taste.
why_digital: Photos and descriptions are embedded and recommended entirely online.

why_ai: Mining logged null searches and expired listings is straightforward analytics on existing data.
why_clarity: Unmet demand is measurable from logs, though acting on it shows later.
why_digital: Search logs and listing data analysed entirely in software.
